title: Harvard Museum of Natural History

services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: General admission gives access to all exhibits, including the Glass Flowers Gallery. Tickets can only be purchased at the admissions desk and the museum shop. The museum is connected to the Peabody Museum of Archaeology & Ethnology, and admission to one museum admits you to both during regular hours.Adults:

services.name: Guided tour
services.desc: Pre-reserved groups of 10 or more receive discounted admission. Group Visits for grades K-12 offer an opportunity to make the museum your classroom and to develop focused connections between your curriculum and the 12,000 specimens on display. Group Visits are scheduled between 9:00 am and 5:00 pm, 7 days a week. The maximum number of students is 150. Larger groups may need to stagger arrival times or schedule across multiple days. Please complete the online Reservation Request Form at least two weeks in advance to begin the reservations process. When the request has been reviewed, you will be contacted by the Education Department to complete the reservation. We request payment by credit

blurb: When you imagine a museum, you might picture cases of artifacts. But the objects on display at the Harvard Museum of Natural History are a tiny percentage of the total collections. Behind the scenes, experts care for 26 million specimens. These objects form the basis for studying life on Earth. They are records of the planet from different times and places.
hoursText: Open daily from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm
